evals.prompt: Review this destructive confirm handler on a delete modal: `const onConfirm = () => { onDelete(); onClose(); };`. onDelete returns a promise but is not awaited, there is no busy guard, and the modal closes immediately.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: C5 — async-confirm pattern: busy guard, await, stay open on failure, never fire-and-forget
evals.expected_output: C5 FAILs. The confirm is fire-and-forget: the onDelete promise is not awaited, there is no re-entry (busy) guard so a double-click fires the delete twice, and the modal closes before the destructive action resolves (so a failure is lost). Fix: guard re-entry (if (busy) return), setBusy(true) and clear prior error, await onDelete inside try/catch, close only on success, on rejection stay open and surface the error inline (C6), and clear busy in finally. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Cites missing busy re-entry guard and/or closing before the action resolves
